verdict.rationale: No evidence of a lockfile, pinned-skill-version mechanism, or opt-in update gating for teams; the only version-related artifacts are the ship workflow's own VERSION/CHANGELOG bump and a generic gstack-upgrade skill, neither of which lets a lead pin or gate skill updates for teammates. Community commentary even flags the git-clone-and-copy install model as lacking per-repo governance for divergent review/QA needs.
